correctness.rationale: Every one of the 20 three-column minors is invertible mod 5. Consequently each geometric common zero has at least four nonzero x-coordinates and Jacobian rank 3. Finite squaring map to a P2 ensures dimension 2; connectedness, adjunction and Koszul cohomology establish a smooth integral K3. Exact standard-library enumeration over F5 and F25 gives 96 and 1176 projective points, with independent direct F5 enumeration. For the 22 weight-two Frobenius eigenvalues, squared trace 550=22*25 saturates the triangle inequality, hence every squared eigenvalue 25; trace 70 determines 18 positive and 4 negative eigenvalues. This proves the full zeta and all extension point counts, not merely finite checks. Source code and paths included.
